guide.summary: University museums, libraries, colleges and the river, with breakfast spots, pubs, dinners, bakeries and late bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: The History of Science Museum is closed on Mondays and the Pitt Rivers Museum opens only at 12.00 on most Mondays, so plan museum time for another day if you can.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The History of Science Museum is closed on Mondays, and the Museum of Natural History closes on 24, 25 and 26 December. Magdalen College is closed to visitors from 22 to 31 December.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Christ Church releases its tour tickets each Friday, and the Bodleian's Old Library and Radcliffe Camera can be seen only on a booked tour. The Ashmolean strongly recommends booking for Aphrodite: The Making of a Goddess.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins
toolkit.copy: The Grand Café does not reserve tables, and Magdalen Bridge Boathouse says there is no need to book a punt Monday to Friday. Oli's Thai takes bookings only through its website.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: Christ Church refuses bags larger than 40cm x 30cm x 20cm and has no left luggage, and the Museum of Natural History has no cloakroom. Oli's Thai doesn't admit children under 12, and The Perch takes cards only.

guide.dek: Book Christ Church and any Bodleian tour first, then fill the gaps with Oxford's free museums and a punt from Magdalen Bridge.
intro: Oxford's university museums make an easy first day, and several are free. The Ashmolean on Beaumont Street opens daily from 10am to 5pm with free general entry, and its ticketed exhibition Aphrodite: The Making of a Goddess runs from 8 October 2026 to 11 April 2027; the museum strongly recommends booking for it. On Parks Road, the Museum of Natural History is free and open daily from 10:00 to 17:00, with its exhibition '34: The critical raw materials shaping our future on until 13 April 2027. You reach the Pitt Rivers Museum through it.

For the libraries, you can walk into the Weston Library on Broad Street without a ticket, but the Old Library and the Radcliffe Camera are open to you only on a booked Bodleian tour, with 30-minute guided tours from £12.50. Wonder of Birds is on show until 3 January 2027. Christ Church on St Aldate's releases tour tickets each Friday, turns away bags larger than 40cm x 30cm x 20cm and has no left luggage; its Picture Gallery is closed for refurbishment. Magdalen College charges adults £10 and takes card payments only.

On the river, Magdalen Bridge Boathouse hires self-drive punts for up to five people at £35 an hour and is open daily from 1 February (weather permitting) to 30 November; you don't need to book Monday to Friday. The Oxford Botanic Garden on Rose Lane sells tickets at the door but recommends booking at busy times, and admits only assistance dogs. A short way out, the Cherwell Boathouse on Bardwell Road and The Perch at Binsey both take table bookings, and The Perch accepts cards only, not cash.

For food, The Grand Café on the High Street doesn't reserve tables and opens at 9am every day. Quod at the Old Bank Hotel serves breakfast from 7am, and The King's Arms on Holywell Street serves breakfast Monday to Saturday. In Jericho, Branca's deli on Walton Street opens from 8am to 8pm daily and Brasserie Blanc runs Moules Mondays. Oli's Thai on Magdalen Road takes bookings only through its website and doesn't admit children under 12. For a late drink, Raoul's on Walton Street stays open until 2am on Fridays and Saturdays.
summaryCards: Pair a booked Bodleian tour and a Christ Church ticket with free time at the Ashmolean and the Museum of Natural History.
Start with breakfast at Quod or The Vaults & Garden, then take a punt from Magdalen Bridge Boathouse.
Check Christ Church's 2026 closure list and note that Magdalen College closes to visitors from 22 to 31 December.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several official sites could not be read and those places were left out: the Covered Market and Turf Tavern (certificate errors), Blackwell's, Graduate Oxford, The Alchemist, Kazbar and The Old Bookbinders (403), Jericho Coffee Traders (429), Gee's and the Old Parsonage (connection errors), Turl Street Kitchen, Society Café, The Bear Inn and The Store Hotel (domains did not resolve), and Freud (no readable content). Opening hours were not published on the pages read for Christ Church, the Botanic Garden, Cherwell Boathouse, The Missing Bean and Pierre Victoire, and Malmaison's bar hours were not shown. Raoul's, Oli's Thai and Pierre Victoire showed no dated 2026 content, and Arbequina's Cowley Road hours were inconsistent on its own page.

The fetch tool would not return it word for word, so it is recorded here by description only; it was ignored.
hsm.ox.ac.uk/plan-your-visit: a line asking AI assistants to quote text addressed to them; ignored (fetch tool did not return it verbatim).

2026-10-27: both pages were opened in a browser and their full HTML searched; no AI-directed text was present. The described wording (quote limits, verbatim rules) matches the fetch tool describing its own instructions.
